pin_treatment.adjudicated_claim: The current goal (GOAL-prompt-gate-closeout-v5.md §3.6, echoed by packets/a0-2-requirement-contract.md line 68) states the checklist is contract-pinned and that a checklist edit and its manifest re-pin must land in the same commit.
pin_treatment.adjudication: REFUTED at this head. The checklist has no live digest pin. Re-pinning is not owed and would be destructive.
verified_at_source: contracts/contract-manifest.v1.json (sha256:99de2860…): 0 occurrences of 'completion-checklist'; no docs/handover path among its owner sources. The contract manifest is the live pinning mechanism and it does not pin the checklist.

docs/handover/a5-integration-source-manifest.v1.json (sha256:bf100e9c…): protocol mycelium.combined_candidate_source_manifest.v1, base_commit 0281498298f4b51a8fb656c9c3b3ddc9f082e225, 1124 pins; it pins the checklist at sha256:e66fdd5eac0f015aac44bf6d52a535ca1f4111c3fcfcd391402cf659957cd8bb, size_bytes 78592.

That pin is CORRECT for its own base: git show 0281498298f4b51a8fb656c9c3b3ddc9f082e225:docs/handover/mycelium-completion-checklist.v1.json hashes to e66fdd5eac0f015aac44bf6d52a535ca1f4111c3fcfcd391402cf659957cd8bb and measures 78592 bytes (verified by this lane). The base commit is an ancestor of this head (git merge-base --is-ancestor exit 0).

The checklist on this head is 79117 bytes / sha256:9aa26146…, so the historical pin does not describe it — by design: that file describes the 1124-file candidate of commit 02814982, and rewriting its sha256/size_bytes would make a retained artifact lie about its own base commit (ERRATA-34).

No live enforcement: the only test naming that protocol (tests/a8_acceptance/test_prospective_source_selection.py) constructs its own manifest dict in-test; scripts/contract_audit.py never mentions the checklist or docs/handover; the completion audit reads the checklist as data to validate, not as a pinned source.

mycelium_internet/physical.py reads the combined manifest only as the trust root for the historical A8 source-binding digest (it requires the manifest's own digest to equal the recorded expected digest before verifying pins), so editing that manifest would invalidate historical A8 binding verification rather than satisfy a live obligation.
pin_treatment.consequence: A future checklist edit needs the edit and nothing else; the historical manifests stay immutable.
